title: fix(plugin-detail): reveal the inline-edit pencil on keyboard focus
body:
Part of #25883
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Item 1 of #25883: the record page's read-mode inline-edit pencil now shows on keyboard focus, not only on hover. Item 2 (remember the empty-field toggle) has an open storage-key choice and stays on the card; #25883 remains open.

## What changed

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`, the details body: the pencil beside an editable field was `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`. It is a real button, so a Tab stop landed on a control the user could not see, and the shared `Button` focus ring was drawn at opacity 0. It now also carries `group-focus-within:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx`, the highlights strip: the same pencil gets the same two utilities.
- The spelling is the one `RowActionMenu` (plugin-grid) and `data-table` (components) already use for their hover-revealed row buttons. `focus-visible` reveals the pencil while it has keyboard focus. `group-focus-within` reveals it while anything in its own field has focus, for example a lookup's link in the value.
- Unchanged: the hover reveal, the row's hover background and `title` hint, double-click to edit, the pencil's accessible name (`detail.editInlineHint`), and every locale pack.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/plugin-detail.json` was re-recorded with `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` under the verify lock. The artefact is unchanged; only this package's record moved.
- `.changeset/25883-pencil-focus-reveal.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

## Tests

New: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/inlineEditPencil.focusReveal-25883.test.tsx`, 8 tests, covering both places.

jsdom has no layout and no CSS engine, so it cannot measure "visible on focus". The tests pin the contract a browser turns into visibility:
- the pencil is an enabled, focusable `button` and takes focus;
- it carries `focus-visible:opacity-100` and `group-focus-within:opacity-100` next to the unchanged `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`;
- the shared Button's `focus-visible:ring-2` survives the className merge;
- the nearest `.group` ancestor is the pencil's own field, so focus in one field reveals only that field's pencil.

Activation of the focused pencil, double-click on the value, and no pencil on computed or non-editable fields are asserted as behaviour. The pencil is found by its icon, not by its localized label.

- **Red first, at base `2409c9c8d7` with the fix absent:** `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)`. Both failures are at the `focus-visible:opacity-100` assertion, one for `DetailSection` and one for `HeaderHighlight`. Focusability, hover and double-click were already green there, which is the defect: a focusable but invisible control.
- **Green, at head `76d5a63f`** (the fix, plus `origin/main` 6633075b merged in), from cwd `ui/` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 305 passed | 1 skipped (306)`, `Tests 2833 passed | 18 skipped (2851)`. All 306 test files under plugin-detail ran, the new one included. The same run on the pre-merge head `55fe5e19` read the same counts.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the new test is compiled): exit 0.
  - `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0. The artefact is unchanged, and 27 package records are current.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head `76d5a63f`: 45 commands.
- 44 run locally, each exit 0, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `pnpm check:test-source-alias`, `pnpm check:type-check-coverage` and the changeset gates.
- NOT-MEASURED: `pnpm check:type-check-debt`. Its re-measure waits on the shared verify lock for a closure build and then runs tsc over every package. It was still waiting on the lock at a 300 s cap on a contended box, so it is left to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `45 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 44 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0.
- CI runs every other family (lint, the type-check lanes, Build and E2E UI). This PR cites CI rather than re-running them locally.

## Acceptance notes

- **Copy button, same hover-only class, not changed here.** In `DetailSection.tsx` the copy button drawn beside a read-only, copyable field has the same `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100` and is also a Tab stop. The claim scopes this PR to the pencils, so it is reported to the seat rather than fixed here.
- **The pencil's tooltip text.** The tooltip, which Radix opens on keyboard focus, reads `detail.editInlineHint` ("Double-click to edit"). A keyboard user activates the pencil with Enter or Space. Locale packs are out of this claim's scope; this is left as an open question to the seat.
- **Touch.** The pencil is still not revealed on a coarse pointer. `RowActionMenu` adds `pointer-coarse:opacity-100` for that case. The mobile read row's missing edit path is out of this claim's scope.
- **Landing order.** On the plugin-detail line this lands after #26055 and #26277. Neither touches `DetailSection.tsx` or `HeaderHighlight.tsx`.
